title: Trajectory check-in scratch - 1:1 prep (Maya Chen)
content:
Goal: Quick, targeted 1:1 with Maya (30m). Focus on trajectory signals (impact, autonomy, blockers), concrete coaching, and 2–3 clear next actions. Keep notes terse and actionable.

Context / recent signals
- Release cadence: Maya shipped feature flag rollout for prefix cache heuristic (INF-4821). Good job owning rollout + canary. Small perf wins but not yet on cost metrics.
- PR throughput: 4 PRs merged last 6 weeks (2 large, 2 small). Review lag ~48–60h on average. She’s balancing infra work + mentoring two ICs.
- On-call: 1 P1 in last month (S3 autoscaler bug). Maya led the postmortem and remediation (good).
- Career signal: Vocal in tech design reviews; next step is visible cross-team impact and shipping higher-risk initiatives end-to-end.

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick check-in (3m) - how are you feeling about workload + energy? any immediate blockers?
2) Signals review (7m) - surface wins and gaps: shipping, reviews, ownership areas.
3) Coaching / career (12m) - discuss pathway to Senior Staff (or equivalent next band): scope, examples needed, risks.
4) Action items and commitments (6m) - 2–3 measurable next steps + timelines.

Key questions to ask Maya
- Which part of current work feels highest leverage for you? what would you double-down on if you could change priorities?
- For the cache heuristic rollout, what's the next metric to move (p50 latency? cost per token?) and do you have a quick experiment to try?
- Where do you want more support: blocking reviews, stakeholder alignment, or technical design critiques?
- Do you feel visible to other squads/product owners for bigger cross-cutting initiatives? If not, what would help?

Coaching pointers (notes to self)
- Push on framing: when pitching cross-team work, lead with customer/latency impact + rough cost delta. Give a one-slide skeleton so product/infra understand tradeoffs quickly.
- Delegation: encourage clearer ownership split with the two mentees — set per-PR owners so review lag drops (target <48h).
- Career steps: need 2 examples of end-to-end ownership with ambiguous tradeoffs and measurable outcome (latency/cost/ops reduction). Draft a short story template she can use.

Suggested concrete asks for Maya (these become action items)
1) Short experiment: Run A/B for cache heuristic with 24–48h window, track p50/p95 latency and tokens per second. Deliver results in 2 weeks. (owner: Maya, due: 2027-07-16)
2) Review cadence: Set up PR rotation with mentees — implement a weekly review slot and reduce mean review time to <48h. Report weekly by next 1:1. (owner: Maya, due: 2027-07-09)
3) Visibility: Draft a 1-slide summary of the prefix cache project highlighting impact/risks and share with infra and product. I will intros to two product leads after you post. (owner: Maya + Taylor, due: 2027-07-12)

Potential blockers we should resolve
- Mentee bandwidth: if mentees are overloaded, consider shifting non-critical infra bugs to triage queue or pairing to unblock.
- Instrumentation gaps: Need a simple dashboard for experiment metrics; ping observability team if ETA > 3 working days. Linked artifact: PR #1904 has instrumentation start.

Notes for follow-up (my action items)
- Intro to product leads (Olivia Park, Samuel Rivera) after Maya posts one-slide (status: pending, due: 2027-07-12).
- Offer to join first cross-team sync as moderator to help frame impact (status: offered).
- Check with observability on ETA for dashboard (Jira INF-4899) and escalate if delayed.

Risks / escalation thresholds
- If review lag stays >72h for another two cycles, escalate to TLs and propose rotating reviewer policy.
- If experiment shows regression in p95 > 5% or CPU cost > +10%, pause rollout and schedule postmortem.

Misc scratch notes (things to say)
- "You’ve shown solid ownership with the rollout — next step is translating that into cross-team leverage. Let’s pick one visible metric to move together."
- "Small experiments + faster review cycle is the highest leverage path to demonstrate scaling impact."

Post-meeting quick template (fill after 1:1)
- Date: 2027-07-02
- Mood: 
- Agreed actions: (1) , (2) , (3)
- My commits: 
- Follow-ups to schedule: 1) check experiment results 2) intros to product leads 3) review rotation status

References / links to show in meeting
- INF-4821 (rollout ticket)
- PR: serving-runtime#1904 (instrumentation)
- Example one-slide template: (shared drive template link)

Quick time-box reminders to self: keep coaching concrete, avoid airing broader org grievances in this 1:1, focus on what Maya can do in next 2 weeks to create signal.

-- end of scratch --
